source.sourceInput: F-Log2 / F-Gamut (BT.2020 primaries), full range 0–1; not F-Log2C / F-GamutC
source.sourceOutput: BT.709 primaries, gamma 2.2 display interpretation following official whitepaper p13; converted to sRGB for this application
source.rights: Official LUT data © FUJIFILM Corporation, rights retained; no CC relicensing of FUJIFILM data. spektrafilm paper profiles/code retain their original licenses and attribution.

inputAdapter.std: sRGB decode -> shared PROVIA neutral-response inverse using a common RGB gain -> virtual scene RGB -> BT.2020/F-Gamut -> official F-Log2 encoding, code clamp 0..1. Same mapping for all ten simulations and photos; NOT a measured camera inverse.

stdCalibration.input: encoded sRGB / already rendered Standard JPEG, RGB 0..1
stdCalibration.neutralSamplingDomain: F-Log2 code from scene-linear 0 to code 1
stdCalibration.formula: sceneRGB = linearDisplayRGB * inverse_PROVIA_Y(displayY) / displayY; exact RGB black maps to scene black
stdCalibration.inverse: piecewise-linear inverse of the monotone accumulated source neutral curve; earliest code for plateaus; bounded to sampled endpoints
limitations: A shared virtual scene reconstruction for rendered JPEGs, not an inverse of a measured LUMIX or GFX photo style.
Uses PROVIA as a neutral reference; selected simulations retain their relative official tone and color differences.
Velvia and other contrasty source looks can still darken shadows relative to PROVIA.
Camera white balance, local tone mapping, clipping and lost JPEG detail cannot be recovered.

inputAdapter.vlog: V-Log decode -> V-Gamut to F-Gamut linear matrix -> official F-Log2 encoding, code clamp 0..1. This bounds negative/out-of-F-Gamut coordinates in code space: code0 corresponds to negative linear reflection, not linear0. No extra display shoulder. Not a measured sensor match.
inputAdapter.output: Official BT709/gamma2.2 interpretation -> linear -> optional virtual paper -> sRGB encoding -> STD-only Film Lab JPG tone protection

jpgToneProtection.input: already rendered encoded sRGB / Standard JPEG
jpgToneProtection.neutralAxis: uniform encoded sRGB 0..1; interpolate OKLab response at equal input linear Y
jpgToneProtection.gamutMapping: reduce OKLab chroma at fixed lightness and hue; exact neutral black/white endpoints
limitations: An explicit Film Lab JPEG rendering policy; not unmodified upstream tonality or an official Fujifilm JPEG recipe.
Keeps model colour differences while reducing repeated tonality; gamut-boundary chroma and contrast can change.
Cannot restore source detail already clipped or lost by the camera.

paperBridge.input: display-linear sRGB / BT.709 primaries, D65, RGB 0..1
paperBridge.output: display-linear sRGB, D65, RGB 0..1; encode sRGB after this stage
paperBridge.calibration: fixed per-stock neutral-ramp printer calibration; no per-image or per-simulation fit

neutralCalibration.inverseInterpolation: monotone PCHIP, no extrapolation; equal-Y plateaus removed at 1e-12

limitations: Virtual digital-printer exposure mapping; not an optical negative-to-paper exposure model.
The neutral-ramp calibration and three-anchor target are Film Lab choices, not measured printer or Fujifilm data.
Printer calibration avoids a second steep tone curve; stock black/white, gray-axis casts and spectral color interactions remain.
Paper development, spectral dyes, viewing illuminant, and gamut compression use the pinned upstream model.
Kodak 2383 and 2393 are motion-picture print films, not photographic paper.
Fujifilm simulation output plus this bridge is a derived creative result, not an official Fujifilm paper rendering.

preview: User Standard digital photo -> exported STD LUT once; not captured on GFX or physical film
